description: This file contains integration tests for the Basket repository in an e-commerce application, specifically testing the 'SetQuantities' functionality which involves modifying basket item quantities, including removing items with zero quantities.

classes.name: SetQuantities
classes.description: A test class for verifying the behavior of setting quantities in a shopping basket, including removing items when quantity is zero.

methods.name: SetQuantities
